title: A mail send that fails shows 'Not sent' with no reason, and the agent carries on as if nothing failed

With several sender accounts the card also starts on 'Choose an account', Send is disabled with no hint, and the header repeats the recipient.
verification: OBSERVED by J3 (phone) and V2 (desktop and phone, the disabled Send). CONFIRMED in code: the error paragraph is guarded by 'mail.outcome === "failed" && mail.error' (MailApprovalCard.tsx:537) and Send is 'disabled={busy || allowDisabled || needsAccount}' (:473). That the agent does not report a failed send is OBSERVED once (J3), cause in the executor path SUSPECTED, not traced. The real cause of the failure on the demo is not confirmed.
files: apps/web/src/components/MailApprovalCard.tsx (default reason line when outcome is failed and error is empty; preselect the account that received the thread; visible hint beside a disabled Send; drop the recipient from the header)

packages/adapters/src/executor.ts or the mail tool result path that tells the agent the outcome (find where outcome 'failed' is returned; include the failure in the tool result so the agent reports it)
apps/web/src/components/MailApprovalCard.test.tsx (failed without error text shows the default line)

title: /app/settings did not open Settings in 4 of 5 loads for V1, though four other walkers saw it work
found_by: V1 (V1-01); contradicted by R1, R2, R3, FLOW (all saw it open)
root_cause: /app/settings redirects to /app?settings=general (App.tsx:249). Shell reads the query in an effect (Shell.tsx:2549), but the first-thread redirects at Shell.tsx:1459 and :1475 call navigate(firstThreadRoute(...), {replace:true}) and drop the query. If those run before the effect has consumed the parameter (slow shell mount), the dialog never opens.

The race is SUSPECTED, not proven. CONFIRMED in code that the redirects do not carry the query (Shell.tsx:1459,1475). Severity P2 because most loads work and Settings is reachable from the account menu.
files: apps/web/src/pages/Shell.tsx (carry window.location.search through firstThreadRoute navigations, or capture the settings parameter in a ref on first render before any redirect)
apps/web/src/pages/Shell.test.tsx (a /app?settings=general load that triggers the first-thread redirect still opens General)
